claim_ceiling: A minimal procedural world that separates compositional-latent inference from lookup/memorization on a held-out, balanced, leak-free metric, with measured headroom vs an ideal (Bayesian) observer -- IF the computed verdict is 'world_discriminates_structure_inference'. Tests NO candidate; not generalization-mechanism evidence; evidences nothing about agency, learning-as-mechanism, self, feeling, or subjectivity. A negative verdict is bounded to THIS world. This run was drafter-implemented in a non-outcome-neutral session and REQUIRES independent audit before its verdict may be treated as banked lab evidence.

metric.margin_rule: margin = max_trivial_baseline + DELTA (reported); pass also requires headroom > DELTA
metric.primary: mean over episodes of per-episode balanced accuracy on held-out queries

verdict_rule.invalid_iff: any planted leak uncaught OR any clean channel falsely flagged
pass_iff_all: all planted leaks caught AND no clean channel falsely flagged

world.heldout_definition: every query property value drawn from heldout_values (unseen during adaptation)
world.rule: effect = (sum_i w_i * x_i + c * a) mod K
